name: Aki Kanna
source:
Hobbies: Cosplay
Likes: Stuffed animals, mascots, accessories
Dislikes: Perverts

A famous cosplayer who often participates in the event "Cos_Toxicosis", and also wears her outfits even in school. Kanna is also part of the light music club together with [url=/c55537]Hisoka[/url], and serves as the band's vocalist and cosplayer. She dislikes it when people take pictures of her secretly, but will gladly show her expert posing techniques if asked permission first.
